name: My Diary ~Kimi ga Boku no Imouto dattara...~
original_name: My Diary ～君が僕の妹だったら…～
source:
Momo, Rika and Nozomi are friends with each other and they have common affection for Tsuyoshi. However, Tsuyoshi gets in a traffic accident and with time girls' attention shift to main character. Protagonist is actually the older brother of Momo. Even though she understands her feelings can't be fulfilled, she can not tolerate that her brother was in love with other girl. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
桃、里香与望是彼此的好友，也都对刚抱有好感。然而，刚遭遇交通事故后，女孩们的注意力逐渐转向主人公。主人公其实是桃的哥哥。尽管明白自己的感情无法实现，桃仍无法忍受哥哥爱上别的女孩。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
